pins.name: SCL
pins.description: I2C clock (pulled up on most modules, 4.7-10 kΩ)

pins.name: SDA
pins.description: I2C data (pulled up on most modules)

notes: Two pin orders are sold: GND VCC SCL SDA (this part) and VCC GND SCL SDA (`SSD1306_OLED_I2C_VCC_FIRST`). Read the module's silkscreen before choosing: the wrong one puts the supply on ground.
I2C address 0x3C (0x3D with the module's address jumper moved). The bus needs pull-ups once: most modules have them; add `I2cPullups` when the bus has none.
